Dart.controlWithArrowKeys:
Set whether to control the dart with the arrow keys; left and right
to adjust the angle, and up and down to increase / decrease power
Dart.controlWithArrowKeys|param|on: whether to turn on or off this feature, eg: true
Dart.setTrace: Set whether to show the trace for the estimated path
Dart.setTrace|param|on: whether to turn on or off this feature, eg: true
Dart.sprite:
NO LONGER NECESSARY -- the dart is now a sprite by itself.
Gets the dart's sprite.
Dart.stopDart: Stop the dart at the current location
Dart.throwDart: Throw the dart with the current settings
Dart.updateBackground: NO LONGER NECESSARY as this uses renderables now to draw onto the background.
darts.create: Creates a new dart from an image and kind
darts.create|param|kind: the kind to make the dart
darts.degreeToRadian:
Convert degrees to radians

@return converted value in radians
darts.xComponent:
Evaluate the x component of a given vector


@return x component of vector
darts.yComponent:
Evaluate the y component of a given vector


@return y component of vector
